messages:
Hannah: Quick flag 12: Orchid Systems (onboarding) triggered a token surge overnight: +195% 24h delta. Adding to QBR cost agenda and renewal watch. :warning:
Diego: Yikes. Which endpoint? Any route-level hotness?
Li: Triage shows most traffic hitting /v1/embeddings from their ingestion worker. Looks like duplicate sends after failed ack.
Tess: I traced the client logs  they're re-sending entire batches on 500s without backoff. That can easily multiply tokens.
Hannah: cs-alert-bot posted alert:
cs-alert-bot: ALERT account=orchid_sys metric=tokens_24h change=+195% link=https://app.redwood/alerts/or-321
Diego: Can someone run a 30d projection (sustained vs remediated) so finance + QBR slides can include exposure?
Li: Quick SQL run -> 24h tokens = 3.0M. Sustained projection ~90M / 30d; remediated scenario estimate ~22M. Uploading CSV to ticket CS-1447.
Tess: I'm applying a temporary soft quota on /v1/embeddings (1.8M/day) and routing non-critical jobs to a quantized embed model to cut per-token spend by ~35%.
Hannah: Good. Let's schedule a 30m enablement session: client retries, batching, and cache TTLs. @Li can you lead?
Li: Yes, I can do tomorrow 9:30am PT. Will prepare a one-pager and a short code snippet for safe retries + idempotency.
Diego: From a renewal POV, add "unexpected embed surge" to the risk tracker and propose three resolution paths for the QBR: 1) enablement + monitoring, 2) small one-time goodwill credit, 3) paid enablement + SLA for future spikes.
Hannah: Action owners: billing forecast & slide (Diego), enablement + docs (Li), throttle & model fallback (Tess), renewal tracker update + customer comms (Hannah).
cs-alert-bot: NOTE: quota applied route=/v1/embeddings account=orchid_sys soft_limit=1800000 tokens/day. Ticket=CS-1447
Li: After the call I'll capture product requests (client helper lib for batching, server-side idempotency token) and label quick-wins vs roadmap.
Tess: I'll monitor for 24h and rollback throttle once retries are fixed.
Diego: Posted spend scenarios to the QBR folder. Conservative = $2.7k/mo, aggressive (if sustained) = $8.5k/mo. Adding renewal tag "monitoring".
Hannah: We'll decide on credit vs paid enablement after the enablement call. Closing loop for now  will update the tracker post-call. :white_check_mark:
